# apple_subscription_price_point_equalizations (Data Source)

Lists the price points in other territories that are equivalent to a subscription price point, for setting each territory's `apple_subscription_price`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_subscription_price_point_equalizations" "usd" {
  price_point_id = data.apple_subscription_price_points.usd.price_points[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `price_point_id` (String) ID of the price point.

### Optional

- `territories` (Set of String) Only equivalents in these territories, e.g. `GBR`.

### Read-Only

- `price_points` (Attributes List) The equivalent price points. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--price_points))

<a id="nestedatt--price_points"></a>
### Nested Schema for `price_points`

Read-Only:

- `customer_price` (String) Price customers pay, in the territory's currency, e.g. `0.99`.
- `id` (String) ID of the price point, for `apple_app_price_schedule`.
- `proceeds` (String) Proceeds per sale, in the territory's currency.
- `territory` (String) Territory of the price point, e.g. `USA`.
